item.text: I found the ambiguity: the utility falls back to `0` both when storage is empty and when parsing fails. Since `0` can be a real session ID, I’ll return `null` for absence or invalid data and have the bookmarks view call `resumeSession` only when it has an ID.

The utility and bookmarks view are updated. I added coverage for empty and malformed storage, invalid suffixes, a valid ID of `0`, and restoring a saved password through the bookmarks view. The targeted tests are running now.
The first test command produced no output, so I stopped it and launched the installed Jest binary directly. That run is still active. I’m also checking the final diff for ID parsing edge cases.

item.text:
Fixed public bookmark session restoration. [getLastPersistedLocalID](/app/applications/drive/src/app/utils/lastActivePersistedUserSession.ts) now returns a valid numeric ID or `null`, ignores unrelated and invalid keys, and preserves ID `0`. The [bookmarks view](/app/applications/drive/src/app/store/_views/useBookmarksPublicView.ts) resumes a session only when an ID exists, allowing it to restore a saved key password.

Both relevant Jest suites passed (19 tests). Prettier and `git diff --check` passed.
